data.one_liner: A simple modal sheet implementation that appears from the top of the screen.
data.what_it_does: Provides a function to display a modal sheet sliding down from the top of the screen. Returns a value when the modal sheet is dismissed.
use_when: You need to display a modal sheet from the top of the screen instead of the bottom.
You want a straightforward way to capture user input or display temporary content from the top.
avoid_when: You need standard bottom sheets provided by Flutter material library.
You require complex navigation stacks inside the sheet.
strengths: Simple API with a single function call to show the modal sheet.
Cross-platform support across Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Limited documentation and configuration options are only briefly mentioned in changelogs.
Not documented for advanced customization features.
